headline: Does AirJoule Technologies (AIRJ) Using GE Vernova’s Campus Showcase Reframe Its Industrial Water Strategy?
summary: In July 2026, AirJoule Technologies Corporation deployed its AirJoule Core atmospheric water generation system at GE Vernova’s new Advanced Research Center Frontier Campus in Niskayuna, New York, where it now operates as a live showcase producing distilled water directly from air for visiting customers and partners. This installation deepens the 50/50 joint venture between AirJoule and GE Vernova, giving potential industrial and data center users a real-world view of how modular on-site...
